meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证 AI 编程助手的命令、界面与数据记录是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要验证 opencode 的命令、插件触发及会话数据是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on or use an AI coding assistant and need to verify its CLI, plugin events, or session history

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能在你要求时对 opencode 做质检:检查命令行、服务器接口、插件事件、终端界面和会话数据库,并执行自带测试脚本验证功能是否正常。
howto.when: 当你说出“opencode qa”“test opencode”等词,或要求验证/调试 opencode 的命令行、服务器、插件事件、界面,或查找数据库里的会话时触发。

say.text: 测试一下 opencode 的命令行能否正常运行
say.note: 会运行隔离环境中的 QA 脚本并给出结果。

say.text: 按 ID ses_3a4e... 查一下这个会话的数据库记录
say.note: 会以只读方式查询并输出该会话的 JSON。

say.text: 验证服务器的 /event 接口和插件钩子是否触发
say.note: 会启动 SSE 探测脚本确认事件流。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can QA/debug opencode itself: run tested scripts to verify the CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in the SQLite DB by id/name/text.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like "opencode qa" or "test opencode", or by requests to QA/smoke-test/verify/debug opencode's CLI, server, plugin hooks/events, TUI, or find/inspect DB sessions.

say_en.text: Check whether the opencode CLI works
say_en.note: It runs the QA script in an isolated sandbox and reports the result.

say_en.text: Look up session ses_3a4e... in the database
say_en.note: Queries read-only and outputs that session as JSON.

say_en.text: Verify the /event endpoint and plugin hooks fire
say_en.note: It starts the SSE probe script to confirm the event stream.
